title: Historic Mansion Sale Soars: Nantucket’s Hadwen-Wright House fetches $15.25 million; hidden cistern preserved
summary_full: The Hadwen-Wright House in Nantucket fetched an impressive $15.25 million, after being originally listed at $15.5 million. This stunning mansion, a prime example of Greek Revival architecture, is steeped in history. Its extensive renovations not only maintained original features but also unveiled a unique brick-lined cistern now preserved for guests. This sale highlights the lasting appeal of Nantucket's historically significant residences.
